setting.note: Middle-earth is invented, so this map holds only the real places Tolkien drew on: the Birmingham water mill behind Bag End and Hobbiton, the West Midlands hills and river country of his boyhood, and, far off the map, the Swiss valley and high Alps that fed Rivendell and the Misty Mountains after his 1911 walking tour.

palette.note: The dwarf-gold of Thorin's hoard under the Lonely Mountain, the treasure that pulls the whole journey east. A cited book's colour is not a quotation; it still has to be legible, and this clears WCAG AA on paper.
